births_total_and_sex_ratio.source: 內政部戶政司 人口統計資料 歷年全國人口統計資料 > 出生及死亡 01. 出生數及粗出生率(按登記及發生) — sheets 全國(登記) and 全國(登記)-不含金門縣及連江縣
births_total_and_sex_ratio.unit: live births registered in year (persons); sex_ratio = boys per 100 girls; cbr = crude birth rate per 1000 mid-year population
births_total_and_sex_ratio.notes: Registration-date basis (按登記日期). Total and CBR from sheet 全國(登記). Births by sex for the whole country are only published from 1980; for 1961-1979 male_taiwan_area/female_taiwan_area come from the Taiwan-area sheet (excludes Kinmen & Matsu; its totals are ~0.5% lower than the national total) and sex_ratio is computed from those. 2025 is the latest full year (107,812 births, CBR 4.62).

total_fertility_rate.source: 內政部戶政司 歷年全國人口統計資料 > 出生及死亡 10. 育齡婦女生育率及繁殖率(按發生)
total_fertility_rate.unit: children per woman (official value in per-mille / 1000)
total_fertility_rate.notes: Occurrence-date basis; up to 1973 excludes Kinmen & Matsu and is by registration date. 2010 (0.895) was the Tiger-year low before 2022+; 2025 = 0.695. MOI also publishes an "adjusted" series from 1998 (sheet 調整後育齡) that differs slightly; the unadjusted official series is used here.

fertility_rate_by_mother_age.source: 內政部戶政司 歷年全國人口統計資料 > 出生及死亡 10. 育齡婦女生育率及繁殖率(按發生)
fertility_rate_by_mother_age.unit: births per 1000 women of that age group per year (age-specific fertility rate); gfr = general fertility rate per 1000 women 15-49
fertility_rate_by_mother_age.notes: Sum of 5-year ASFRs x 5 = TFR (per mille). 45-49 values from 2004 onward are tiny fractions as published.

population_national.source: 內政部戶政司 歷年全國人口統計資料 > 09. 人口年增加及出生死亡率 (全國, year-end) and 04. 年中人口按性別及五齡組 (mid-year, 1975+)
population_national.url: https://www.ris.gov.tw/info-popudata/app/awFastDownload/view (POST m4c=y1s3, type=xls; via https://www.ris.gov.tw/app/portal/346) ; https://www.ris.gov.tw/info-popudata/app/awFastDownload/view (POST m4c=y1s9, type=xls; via https://www.ris.gov.tw/app/portal/346)
population_national.notes: Year-end registered population incl. Kinmen & Matsu. Mid-year: official table from 1975; for 1961-1974 computed with MOI's own definition (previous year-end + current year-end)/2 and listed in est. Peak year-end population 23,603,121 (2019).

population_by_county.source: 內政部戶政司 年度縣市及全國統計資料 > 01. 縣市人口按性別及五齡組 (表一 各縣市人口數按性別及五歲年齡組分)
population_by_county.unit: [total, male, female] persons at year-end, by county/city as administratively constituted that year
population_by_county.notes: Available 1974 (民國63年底) onward only; county-level year-end population for 1961-1973 was not found in any downloadable official table (exists only in printed 臺閩地區人口統計 yearbooks). Historical units kept: 臺北縣 (→新北市 2010-12-25), 臺中縣+臺中市, 臺南縣+臺南市, 高雄縣+高雄市 merged into municipalities 2010-12-25 (year-end 2010 already shows new units); 桃園縣→桃園市 2014-12-25 (2014 already 桃園市). 新竹市 and 嘉義市 were split off from 新竹縣/嘉義縣 on 1982-07-01 (before 1982 they are included in the county). 高雄市 became a special municipality 1979-07-01, absorbing 小港鄉 from 高雄縣 (small boundary changes like this are not adjusted). In years <=2009 the keys 臺中市/臺南市/高雄市 are the pre-merger cities.

population_by_county_22.unit: persons at year-end, aggregated to today's 22 counties/cities
population_by_county_22.notes: Aggregation: 臺北縣→新北市; 桃園縣→桃園市; 臺中縣+臺中市→臺中市; 臺南縣+臺南市→臺南市; 高雄縣+高雄市→高雄市. For 1974-1981 新竹縣 includes 新竹市 and 嘉義縣 includes 嘉義市 (cities absent); these cannot be separated from the official table. Pre-2010 boundaries of the merged areas are identical to today's, so the aggregation is exact.

births_by_county_sex.source: 內政部統計處 內政統計查詢網 > 戶政 > 出生 > 出生人數(登記日期)性別概況─按區域別分 (funid c0120101)
births_by_county_sex.url: https://statis.moi.gov.tw/micst/webMain.aspx?sys=220&funid=c0120101 (內政統計查詢網; yearly cycle, CSV)
births_by_county_sex.unit: [total, male, female] live births registered in year, by county/city as reported that year
births_by_county_sex.notes: Registration basis, 1994 (民國83年) onward — the query system starts 1994. Units as reported: old 臺北縣/臺中縣/臺中市/臺南縣/臺南市/高雄縣/高雄市 through 2009, new municipalities from 2010; 桃園縣 through 2013, 桃園市 from 2014 (labels drop the "(99年改制前)" suffix: in years <=2009 臺中市/臺南市/高雄市 mean the pre-merger cities). County sums equal the national total each year. County births by sex before 1994 were not obtainable (see births_by_county_occurrence_22 for 1981-1993 totals). 2007+ values also cross-checked against ris table 鄉鎮市區出生死亡結婚離婚 (y0sm).

births_by_county_sex_22.source: 內政統計查詢網 c0120101 (MOI back-filled current-municipality columns)
births_by_county_sex_22.url: https://statis.moi.gov.tw/micst/webMain.aspx?sys=220&funid=c0120101 (內政統計查詢網; yearly cycle, CSV)
births_by_county_sex_22.unit: [total, male, female] live births registered, aggregated to today's 22 counties/cities
births_by_county_sex_22.notes: 1994-2025. MOI itself publishes the 新北市/臺中市/臺南市/高雄市/桃園市 columns back-filled for pre-merger years (= sum of old units); sums verified equal to national totals.

births_by_county_occurrence_22.source: 內政統計查詢網 > 出生人數(發生日期)生母年齡概況─按區域別分 (funid c0120105), 總計 column
births_by_county_occurrence_22.url: https://statis.moi.gov.tw/micst/webMain.aspx?sys=220&funid=c0120105 (內政統計查詢網; yearly cycle, CSV)
births_by_county_occurrence_22.unit: live births by year of occurrence (persons), today's 22 counties/cities (MOI back-filled municipality columns)
births_by_county_occurrence_22.notes: Occurrence-date basis (按發生日期), totals only (no sex split), 1981-2025. Use for 1981-1993 county births where the registration-basis table does not exist; occurrence and registration totals differ by <1% nationally. 1981: 新竹市/嘉義市 not yet separate (included in 新竹縣/嘉義縣). No official downloadable county-level birth counts were found for 1961-1980; ris annual county tables start 2007 and statis 1981/1994.
